cast.A: young adult with short black hair, wearing a mustard-yellow crewneck sweater and dark navy jeans
cast.B: young adult with shoulder-length brown hair, wearing a light gray long-sleeve henley shirt and olive-green trousers

scenes.scene: young adult with short black hair, wearing a mustard-yellow crewneck sweater and dark navy jeans steps in through a doorway in cold weather, one hand recoiling from a metal door handle, the other hand resting on the wooden door frame; a thermometer on the wall beside them stays blank.
scenes.overlay_hint: 在人物左右两侧各画一个空的温度读数框，两个读数相同
scenes.note: 进门时一只手被铁把手冰得缩回，另一只手扶着木门框却没事
scenes.scene_template: {A} steps in through a doorway in cold weather, one hand recoiling from a metal door handle, the other hand resting on the wooden door frame; a thermometer on the wall beside them stays blank.

scenes.scene: young adult with short black hair, wearing a mustard-yellow crewneck sweater and dark navy jeans stands in a room with a bare forearm, one fingertip pressed against a metal radiator, the other hand held slightly away from it, palm open.
scenes.overlay_hint: 在手臂与金属之间画一排由手臂指向金属的小箭头
scenes.note: 手指按在金属上，热从皮肤往外流走
scenes.scene_template: {A} stands in a room with a bare forearm, one fingertip pressed against a metal radiator, the other hand held slightly away from it, palm open.

scenes.scene: young adult with short black hair, wearing a mustard-yellow crewneck sweater and dark navy jeans on the left and young adult with shoulder-length brown hair, wearing a light gray long-sleeve henley shirt and olive-green trousers on the right sit at a kitchen table, each pressing one fingertip onto a different flat slab, one metal, one wood; two plain glasses of water stand between them.
scenes.overlay_hint: 从两个指尖往下各画一根管子，金属侧画粗管、木头侧画细吸管
scenes.note: 两人在厨房桌边分别用指尖按住金属台面和木台面
scenes.scene_template: {A} on the left and {B} on the right sit at a kitchen table, each pressing one fingertip onto a different flat slab, one metal, one wood; two plain glasses of water stand between them.

scenes.scene: young adult with short black hair, wearing a mustard-yellow crewneck sweater and dark navy jeans leans over a kitchen counter pressing a palm flat on a thick metal block, a large plain metal tray and a pot of water beside it; young adult with shoulder-length brown hair, wearing a light gray long-sleeve henley shirt and olive-green trousers in the background touches a thin wooden board.
scenes.overlay_hint: 金属方块下方画一个很大的空水池轮廓，木板下方画一个很小的空水坑轮廓
scenes.note: 手掌按在整块金属上，金属后面连着大块材料
scenes.scene_template: {A} leans over a kitchen counter pressing a palm flat on a thick metal block, a large plain metal tray and a pot of water beside it; {B} in the background touches a thin wooden board.

scenes.scene: young adult with short black hair, wearing a mustard-yellow crewneck sweater and dark navy jeans sits at a table with one fingertip touching a metal spoon and the other hand resting on a wooden spoon, eyes narrowed slightly as if judging the sensation.
scenes.overlay_hint: 在指尖处画两个不同密度的信号小点，金属侧密、木头侧疏
scenes.note: 指尖分别碰金属勺和木勺，感受温度变化的速度
scenes.scene_template: {A} sits at a table with one fingertip touching a metal spoon and the other hand resting on a wooden spoon, eyes narrowed slightly as if judging the sensation.

scenes.scene: young adult with short black hair, wearing a mustard-yellow crewneck sweater and dark navy jeans stands barefoot on a tiled kitchen floor, one foot lifted while the other rests on a small rug; a plain wooden-handled pan sits on the stove nearby.
scenes.overlay_hint: 在脚下与地面之间画一排朝下的小箭头，瓷砖侧箭头多、地毯侧箭头少
scenes.note: 光脚踩在瓷砖和地毯上，脚感一凉一暖
scenes.scene_template: {A} stands barefoot on a tiled kitchen floor, one foot lifted while the other rests on a small rug; a plain wooden-handled pan sits on the stove nearby.
